motivation: Within pair x species, prior same-site memory increased CI>=2 reactivation but not CI3 alone. Localize the interaction across mutually exclusive wet CallingIndex levels.
population: Exactly the informative cells from NAAMP_PRIOR_SITE_MEMORY_WITHIN_SPECIES_V0_1: prior-known route species absent from the focal dry route, physically stable pairs, and pair x species groups with both prior-used and prior-unused SiteIDs.
model: For each outcome, use the same pair x species fixed-effect demeaning and cluster-robust regression: demeaned outcome ~ demeaned prior_same_site + demeaned(prior_same_site*rain_contrast), no intercept.
primary_localization: Report the three interaction coefficients and 95% CIs. No new omnibus success gate is created; this diagnostic localizes the already-supported CI>=2 interaction.
interpretation: Positive CI2-only with unsupported CI3-only means site-memory selectivity is strongest at overlapping-call chorus intensity rather than specifically at full chorus.
The full population-level CI3 rainfall association remains a separate result.
This is post-readback localization and not a new confirmatory family.
